2609.15888.title: Anatomical Grounding and Leakage-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification from Structural MRI
2609.15888.paper_summary: Deep networks trained on structural MRI for Alzheimer's disease (AD) staging often reach reasonable accuracy while attending to anatomically irrelevant regions, and multimodal models that add clinical tables frequently rely on variables that were used to assign the diagnostic label in the first place. We study both issues with a deliberately lightweight slice-based encoder (ResNet18 with a one-layer Transformer over slices) on 1,075 baseline T1-weighted scans from ADNI-1. First, we use FastSurfer segmentations as an anatomical reference: YOLOv8 models trained on segmentation-derived labels localize Alzheimer-relevant structures with mAP_50 above 0.96, and a Grad-CAM comparison shows that the image-only classifier frequently attends to the skull, orbits and background. Second, we adapt a CLIP-style image - tabular contrastive framework and organize ADNIMERGE variables along a label-leakage spectrum. Fusion with cognitive scores yields 87.3% three-way accuracy, which we treat as a leakage-driven upper bound rather than an imaging result; fusion with regional volumes yields 73.0%. We observe that the choice of contrastive target changes what the image encoder learns: on MCI vs. CN, the image-only head reaches 52.4% when the encoder is aligned to cognitive scores and 73.8\% when aligned to volumes, although no tabular input is used at inference. Third, restricting the input to a per-subject crop of the medial temporal lobe raises image-only three-way accuracy from 58.7% to 65.1%. All results come from single runs on a small balanced test set, and we report confidence intervals and the protocol differences that prevent direct comparison with published numbers.
2609.15888.paper_summary_zh: 深度網絡在結構性MRI上訓練以進行阿茲海默症（AD）分期時，經常能達到合理的準確性，同時關注解剖上無關的區域，而添加臨床表格的多模態模型則經常依賴於最初用來分配診斷標籤的變量。我們使用一個故意輕量的基於切片的編碼器（ResNet18，並在切片上使用一層Transformer）來研究這兩個問題，數據來自ADNI-1的1,075個基線T1加權掃描。首先，我們使用FastSurfer分割作為解剖參考：訓練於分割衍生標籤的YOLOv8模型以mAP_50超過0.96定位與阿茲海默症相關的結構，並且Grad-CAM比較顯示，僅使用影像的分類器經常關注頭骨、眼窩和背景。其次，我們調整了一個CLIP風格的影像-表格對比框架，並沿著標籤洩漏光譜組織ADNIMERGE變量。與認知分數的融合產生87.3%的三分類準確率，我們將其視為一個由洩漏驅動的上限，而不是影像結果；與區域體積的融合則產生73.0%。我們觀察到對比目標的選擇改變了影像編碼器學習的內容：在MCI與CN的比較中，當編碼器對齊認知分數時，僅影像的頭部達到52.4%，而對齊體積時則達到73.8%，儘管在推理時沒有使用表格輸入。第三，將輸入限制為每個受試者的內側顳葉裁剪，將僅影像的三分類準確率從58.7%提高到65.1%。所有結果均來自於小型平衡測試集的單次運行，我們報告置信區間和防止與已發表數字直接比較的協議差異。
2609.15888.author: Paul-Gabriel Nicolae et.al.
